item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second 16:9 silent motion-design ad for ClearDay, a fictional daily planning app. Create the demo interface yourself, not a real product screenshot. Calm minimalist blue-and-white aesthetic, clean flat vector UI, soft rounded cards, generous whitespace, restrained smooth animation. Locked straight-on view, interface fills the landscape frame legibly. 0–2 seconds: a white app panel contains a visually messy cluster of pale-blue task cards, unevenly arranged with small checkboxes and short line marks, conveying a disorganized to-do list. 2–6 seconds: the SAME cards glide gently into an orderly daily schedule, becoming three neatly aligned groups with blue time markers and clear spacing; satisfying coherent sorting motion, a simple daily plan replacing clutter. 6–8 seconds: interface gently fades away to a pristine white background with the exact brand name 'ClearDay' centered in large crisp blue sans-serif lettering. Hold this end frame. No additional titles or slogans required. No people, no device mockups, no complex scenery. Absolutely no sound, speech, music or audio.
